source.label: Card Titan event coverage, 2019 NA Vintage Championship

notes.text: Card Titan published the Top 8 lists only as card-image spreads (cardtitancloud.com/coverage/2019vintage/<player><seed>.png, e.g. brennan7.png). The text was copied from mtgtop8 and checked against those images; no differences.

Placings, seeds and archetype names are from Card Titan's Top 8 bracket and decklist links (final: Joe Brennan beat Boston Schatteman 2-0; semifinals: Schatteman beat Justin Franks 2-1, Brennan beat Bryan Hockey 2-0). Card Titan shows Franks as "Justin F".
Players: 310, the number of rows in Card Titan's final Swiss standings (mtgtop8 also has 310). Swiss was played Friday 2019-11-01; mtgtop8 dates the event to that day.
